facts.fact: Cameroon is home to the rare and endangered Cross River gorilla, found only in the forests along its border with Nigeria.
facts.flagElement: the black gorilla silhouette in the center

facts.fact: Mount Cameroon is one of Africa's most active volcanoes and erupts regularly, with its last major eruption in 2000.
facts.flagElement: the red triangle pointing upward from the bottom

facts.fact: Cameroon's coast is famous for black volcanic sand beaches created by centuries of lava flows meeting the Atlantic Ocean.
facts.flagElement: the horizontal black stripe at the bottom representing the volcanic beaches
